dog.description_text: Meet Tiger — New Arrival! Tiger just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDeJHhcvAKzTrYAKzFirGLTAcSbdVrYai4jxy6TuIQzpJ8?e=NlZcCP His foster says "Around day two, he became curious and started slowly exploring outside of the bathroom. As the days went on, he grew more comfortable and playful. He now loves his food, uses the litter box regularly, and really enjoys playing and receiving affection. He’s still quite shy and cautious when exploring unfamiliar spaces, but he’s a very sweet, gentle cat who just needs some patience and time to feel safe and come out of his shell." She loves "how incredibly sweet and gentle he is, even when he’s feeling scared or shy. It’s been so rewarding watching his personality come out as he gets more comfortable, especially seeing how playful and affectionate he can be! he gets into his playful moods and suddenly forgets how shy he is! It’s so cute watching him slowly sneak out to explore, cautiously checking everything out before getting brave enough to venture a little further. He loves playing with his toys and after a full week he’s turned into a very playful and lovable kitty. He is still shy around visitors (mainly my brother and friend) but doesn’t mind being petted. I love it when he observes my movements with his adorable eyes. I adore his eyes, his soft tail and when he rubs his body against my shins."🥰". He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps.
